tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[A short path from $x$ misses the extended surgery-cap neighborhood $P_0$] Any backward path from $x$ with $\mathcal L$-length less than $L$ is disjoint from the extended cap neighborhood $P_0(\mathcal C)$ associated to every surgery cap $\mathcal C$. \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch ↗ lem:small-L-plus-avoids-surgery-caps The lower scalar-curvature bound $R\geq -6$ changes the $\mathcal L$ bound to $\mathcal L_+\leq L+4(T_{i+1})^{3/2}=L_0$. Lemma 5 excludes the corresponding cap neighborhood.

□
